name: Finance teams
tag: Close the books, not another spreadsheet.
description: Streamline finance workflows while keeping approval and audit controls in place.

cases.title: Invoice processing & approvals
cases.problem: Supplier invoices arrive by email and need manual data entry, purchase-order checks and approval chasing.
cases.solution: Extract key fields, validate against purchase orders, route exceptions for review and prepare draft entries for the finance system.
cases.value: Less rekeying, faster approvals and a clearer audit trail.

cases.title: Accounts receivable follow-ups
cases.problem: Overdue invoices are monitored in spreadsheets and reminders depend on someone remembering to send them.
cases.solution: Identify overdue balances, prepare or send policy-approved reminders and escalate exceptions to the account owner.
cases.value: More consistent follow-up and improved visibility over outstanding payments.

cases.title: Month-end reporting
cases.problem: Teams copy figures between systems, reconcile reports manually and assemble management packs late in the cycle.
cases.solution: Consolidate approved data sources, flag discrepancies and create draft reporting commentary for finance review.
cases.value: Less spreadsheet administration and more time to investigate variances.

name: Asset management
tag: Know what you own. Know what comes next.
description: Track equipment, warranties, maintenance and replacement decisions in one workflow.

cases.title: Asset lifecycle & warranty tracking
cases.problem: Equipment, computers and vehicle records live in disconnected spreadsheets, making renewals and replacements easy to miss.
cases.solution: Consolidate asset records, flag warranty expiry and replacement dates, and create review tasks for asset owners.
cases.value: Better visibility, planned replacements and fewer missed renewals.

cases.title: Preventive maintenance scheduling
cases.problem: Maintenance plans rely on calendar reminders and manual coordination of technicians and suppliers.
cases.solution: Generate work orders from due dates or usage thresholds, notify owners and track completion evidence.
cases.value: More reliable scheduling and clearer maintenance history.

cases.title: Inventory reconciliation
cases.problem: Recorded assets do not always match items deployed, in storage or returned by staff.
cases.solution: Compare inventory exports, detect missing or duplicate records and create reconciliation tasks for authorised staff.
cases.value: More accurate registers and less time spent on manual stocktakes.

name: Retail
description: Connect sales, inventory and customer enquiries without adding extra admin.

cases.title: Low-stock & replenishment alerts
cases.problem: Stores discover popular items are out of stock or reorder too late.
cases.solution: Monitor inventory thresholds and sales velocity, suggest replenishment quantities and route purchase orders for review.
cases.value: Fewer avoidable stockouts and better replenishment planning.

cases.title: Customer enquiry assistant
cases.problem: Staff repeatedly answer the same delivery, returns and product-availability questions.
cases.solution: Use a grounded assistant for approved FAQs and send uncertain or sensitive questions to staff.
cases.value: Faster routine responses and more staff capacity for in-store service.

cases.title: Daily store performance digest
cases.problem: Store managers combine sales, returns and stock figures from multiple reports every day.
cases.solution: Prepare a scheduled daily digest, highlight unusual trends and distribute a review-ready summary.
cases.value: Less report preparation and quicker operational decisions.

name: Local councils
tag: Make community services easier to navigate.
description: Improve request routing, transparent updates and routine administrative workflows.

cases.title: Resident request triage
cases.problem: Pothole, footpath, tree and other reports arrive through multiple channels and need manual routing.
cases.solution: Classify requests, identify the responsible team, create work items and keep residents informed of progress.
cases.value: Faster handoffs and more transparent request tracking.

cases.title: Permit application completeness checks
cases.problem: Staff spend time checking applications for missing information and chasing supporting documents.
cases.solution: Check submissions against published requirements, flag missing items and route completed packs to authorised reviewers.
cases.value: Fewer incomplete applications entering the review queue.

cases.title: Waste & facilities requests
cases.problem: Missed-bin reports, damaged assets and park maintenance tasks are tracked across emails and spreadsheets.
cases.solution: Standardise intake, assign work orders, track contractor updates and notify requestors on completion.
cases.value: More consistent service coordination and fewer status-chasing calls.

name: Schools
tag: Less admin, more focus on learning.
description: Support school operations, parent communications and everyday IT processes.

cases.title: Enrolment administration
cases.problem: Application forms and required documents need repeated manual checking and follow-up.
cases.solution: Securely capture application materials, check completeness and route applications to authorised administration staff.
cases.value: Less paperwork and clearer status tracking for staff.

cases.title: School knowledge assistant
cases.problem: Staff answer routine questions about term dates, uniforms, events and school policies many times.
cases.solution: Offer an assistant that draws only from approved school information and directs sensitive matters to staff.
cases.value: Faster access to school information and fewer repetitive queries.

cases.title: Device allocation & IT requests
cases.problem: Laptop allocations, onboarding and IT support requests require coordination across several teams.
cases.solution: Track device assignments, collect support requests and orchestrate approved access and setup tasks.
cases.value: Simpler handoffs and better device accountability.

name: Trades & field services
tag: Less paperwork. More time on the tools.
description: Help small service businesses move from enquiry to quote, job and invoice.

cases.title: Enquiry-to-quote workflow
cases.problem: Job enquiries arrive by phone, email or social media and quotes are prepared manually after hours.
cases.solution: Capture job details in one form, organise requests and prepare a quote draft for the tradesperson to check.
cases.value: Faster responses and less evening administration.

cases.title: Job scheduling & reminders
cases.problem: Appointments and customer updates are coordinated through calls and individual text messages.
cases.solution: Create appointments from approved jobs, send reminders and provide a simple rescheduling workflow.
cases.value: Clearer schedules and fewer missed appointments.

cases.title: Job completion to invoice
cases.problem: Finished jobs wait to be invoiced while notes, photos and material costs are gathered.
cases.solution: Convert approved completion notes, labour and materials into a draft invoice ready for review.
cases.value: Faster billing and less administrative backlog.

name: Healthcare operations
tag: Protect time for the people who matter.
description: Focus on non-clinical workflows with privacy safeguards and authorised oversight.

cases.title: Appointment administration
cases.problem: Reception teams spend considerable time handling reminders, reschedules and routine appointment questions.
cases.solution: Automate permitted appointment notifications and scheduling follow-ups through approved practice systems.
cases.value: Less repetitive reception work and clearer appointment communication.

cases.title: Referral administration
cases.problem: Referral documents need administrative checks, tracking and routing between teams.
cases.solution: Securely check required fields, flag missing information and route referrals to authorised staff for clinical assessment.
cases.value: Better referral tracking without automating clinical judgment.

cases.title: Equipment & consumables tracking
cases.problem: Supplies and medical equipment need regular stock checking, maintenance and replenishment.
cases.solution: Track thresholds and maintenance dates, create restocking requests and notify responsible staff.
cases.value: Better stock visibility and less manual tracking.
